title: Fedwire/CHIPS Remediation Diff Receipt
description: Diffs an original and a remediated Fedwire/CHIPS structured-address payment file (CSV) record-by-record against the November 2026 lint and produces a remediation-evidence receipt binding both file digests and the rule-clearance delta (non-compliant count before minus after).

originalCsv.description: Raw CSV content of the pre-remediation payment file

remediatedCsv.description: Raw CSV content of the post-remediation payment file

mcp_tool_definition.name: fedwire_remediation_diff_receipt
mcp_tool_definition.description: Diffs an original and a remediated Fedwire/CHIPS structured-address payment file (CSV) record-by-record against the November 2026 lint (lint_fedwire_structured_address rules), aligned by row position, and returns a remediation-evidence receipt binding both file digests and the rule-clearance delta (non-compliant count before minus after). Browser-based, client-side only. Zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/546-fedwire-remediation-diff-receipt.html for interactive use and the tamper-check digest verifier.

originalCsv.description: Raw CSV content of the pre-remediation payment file. Header: network,street_name,building_number,post_code,town_name,country,country_subdivision,address_lines

remediatedCsv.description: Raw CSV content of the post-remediation payment file, same row order as originalCsv
